TOBACCO GROWERS' INFORMATION COMMITTEE, INC.
TELEPHONE 832-3766 • P. O. BOX 12046 CAMERON VILLAGE STATION • RALEIGH, N. C. 27605

October 14, 1970

WILLIAM H. W. ANDERSON
EXECUTIVE SECRETARY-TREASURED
& MANAGING DIRECTOR

Mr. Addison Y. Yeaman
Vice President & General Counsel
Brown & Williamson Tobacco Corp.
1600 West Hill Street
Louisville, Kentucky 40201

Dear Add:

Once more we are inviting friends and those concerned with problems in our Tobacco Community to attend the Twelfth Annual Meeting of the TGIC, at The Velvet Cloak Inn, 1505 Hillsborough Street, Raleigh, North Carolina, at 9:00 A. M. (EST) on Monday, November 2, 1970.
We believe another outstanding program is scheduled. Speakers will be Robert A. Darr, president of the Columbia (S. C.) Land Bank and president of the Federal Intermediate Credit Bank; Milton E. Harrington, president and chief executive officer of Liggett & Myers, Inc., and William A. O'Flaherty, executive director of the Tobacco Tax Council.

Your TGIC friends hope that you will be their guest at a luncheon at The Velvet Cloak following the conclusion of the addresses (about 12:15 P.M.).

The favor of a prompt reply will be appreciated so that we can complete our arrangements.

Cordially,

[SIGNATURE]

680516571

William H. W. Anderson
